== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The remaster prohibits deployment with the indicated Objective and targets Luke, even at Dagobah. It ends when the target reaches the Utinni Effect. Both retain loss during the opponent’s move phase while Vader is present at a battleground site.
